overview:
Salud Carbajal seeks another term in this Central Coast district, which leans about 13 points Democratic. He has raised $1.65 million and holds $3.38 million on hand, while Republican Bob Smith has raised roughly $203,000 with $47,000 available. That financial gap leaves the challenger little capacity to introduce himself to voters or answer attacks.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the assessment rests on district fundamentals, money, and prediction markets, which price a Carbajal win near 98 percent. A favorable national environment could narrow the margin, but a lightly funded challenger rarely overcomes a double-digit partisan lean against an established incumbent. The race is rated Safe Democratic.
